snippet.title: Enigma's Edge™ - Official Reveal Trailer
snippet.description:
Steam - https://store.steampowered.com/app/3202440/Enigmas_Edge/
Epic Games - https://store.epicgames.com/p/enigmas-edge-fea563

Three champions rise from legend—survivors of a lost age, bound by fate's design. Challenged by the dark unknown, they uncover secrets of steel and stone, facing trials of wisdom and might. Every step is a challenge; every shadow a threat. Together they stand against the darkness.

Welcome to Enigma's Edge™ – a roguelike science-fantasy RPG that reimagines classic dungeon crawling for a new generation. Inspired by legendary RPGs like Wizardry 7, this game offers deep exploration, strategic turn-based combat, and immersive environmental puzzles that demand both skill and intellect.

Awakened from a Century of Slumber

You are one of the last surviving crew members of a spaceship that crash-landed on the medieval planet of Delavorn a hundred years ago. Awakened from cryostasis, you now lead a party of three adventurers, navigating a dark labyrinth that blends advanced technology with ancient mysticism. This underground maze is both revered and feared by the locals, but to you, it holds the key to survival.

An Epic Journey Awaits

Explore a rich world of mystery and danger, solve intricate environmental puzzles, and engage in tactical combat where every move could be your last. You'll need to split your party at times, using each character's unique abilities to overcome challenges and unlock hidden paths.

Key Features:

- Strategic Party-Based Gameplay: Control and customize a team of three adventurers, each with specialized skills to overcome the labyrinth's challenges.
- Turn-Based Combat: Tactical, strategic battles where careful planning and execution are crucial.
- Immersive Environmental Puzzles: Interact with a dynamic world, manipulate ancient mechanisms, and solve puzzles essential to your progression.

Your Choices Shape Delavorn

Your decisions will ripple through the world of Delavorn, affecting not only your fate but the world around you. Will you foster harmony or empower chaos? Discover how factions have embraced—or rejected—the advanced technology left in the wake of your ship’s crash.

Inspired by the Classics, Reimagined for Today

Drawing from classic titles like Wizardry 7, Enigma's Edge™ brings dungeon crawling to life with modern 3D visuals, engaging mechanics, and an atmospheric world teeming with lore. Whether you're a veteran of classic RPGs or a newcomer, this journey will test your strategy, wit, and courage.

One Developer, One Vision

For more than 5 years, Enigma's Edge™ has been a solo endeavor, developed in the creator's spare time. This passion project is built on a foundation of creativity and dedication, combining dungeon crawling, puzzles, and strategy into a single unforgettable experience.

Are You Ready to Face the Edge?

Join the adventure today and subscribe for updates, behind-the-scenes content, and sneak peeks at what's to come.
